summary: Perquimans County tower erected 1944 at 99 ft 9 in; a 1959 notice shows it in use; the Perquimans Weekly reports it torn down in 1999.

facts.status_note: Torn down in 1999, according to the Perquimans Weekly.

events.note: 99-foot 9-inch tower erected by the State Forest Service with a cooperative with the U.S. Forest Service.
Notice says smoke seen from the Winfall Fire Tower will be checked by the forest ranger.
Demolition crews tore the tower down, beginning with the top section.

corrections.why: The Perquimans Weekly of October 21, 1999 reports that crews tore the tower down. The record still says status unknown.

notes_for_editor: Build year and height come from a secondary listing that quotes a 1944 state biennial report; the report itself was not read. The 1999 demolition comes from the local paper's OCR text, which is broken in places, so quotes were taken from clean lines only. The 1959 notice shows the tower in use but says nothing about who staffed it. No source describes the site today. Record status should change to removed (see corrections).
